description: Windkraftanlagen in Schleswig-Holstein (WKA) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Shown are locations of wind turbines in Schleswig-Holstein, which have been approved according to the Federal Immission Control Act (BImSchG). Shown are plants that are in operation or approved and are about to be put into operation. The database is an extract from the LIS-A SPC. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines in Schleswig-Holstein (WKA)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Produktions- und Industrieanlagen, Windkraft, gdi-sh, WEA [Windenergieanlage], Alternative Energie, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 2022-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
